kind: paired numeric flip diagnosis; stored answers only

method.score: score_item(frozen_gold_item, result["answer"]) independently for each run; excludes exactly scorer exclusions; abstained answers are incorrect in the denominator. Figure objects from answer.claims take precedence over free text; claims_post and final verifier verdict are not scoring input. Correctness compares absolute magnitudes rounded to reference quantum, not sign correctness or semantic relevance.
method.gold_evidence: Any gold is at least one exact gold chunk in the first ten IDs; sufficient is all chunks of at least one alternative set in first ten. Generator input is the actual ordered context, not pre-rerank and not proof that alternate unlabelled evidence is absent. Rank may exceed 10. Empty gold sets produce null sufficiency.
method.attribution: Primary wrong-side reason is a disjoint description of the observed scoring failure, not a causal component attribution; flags can overlap. score_floor and unsupported are upstream short circuits; otherwise a stored answer abstention is generator decline. Post-generation verifier verdict differences cannot cause score_item changes by themselves.
method.limits: Both runs are development claude_cli, no pinned generation temperature. Router outputs, fallback timing, queries, served input, floor (0.50 vs 0.30), and verifier (NLI vs LLM support judge) can differ. Fallback bypasses floor; combined fallback means any query fell back. Exact rerank scores are not stored, so neither a floor-only effect nor a counterfactual can be inferred absent a controlled paired experiment. PASS is not answer correctness.
